equation_contract.state: S[key,value]; upstream also has a TRANSPOSE_STATE layout.
equation_contract.asymmetry: A is generally nonsymmetric; decay follows the rank-one operation in the adjoint, unlike an incorrect scalar shortcut.
equation_contract.axes: erase b:key; write w:value; decay alpha:key
equation_contract.upstream_qk: Normalize with sqrt(sum(square)+1e-6); query is subsequently scaled by key_dim^-0.5.
equation_contract.upstream_arithmetic: Recurrent state tile/final state FP32; output cast to value dtype. Output precedes gated RMS norm/projection.
equation_contract.upstream_dispatch: In the inspected layer: nontraining q_len<=64 uses recurrent path; otherwise configured chunk path.
equation_contract.model_port_caution: The training-oriented top-level GPT Block call does not pass recurrent cache/use_cache. A verified cached-generation adapter cannot be inferred from standalone recurrent kernels.
equation_contract.local_storage_boundary: Read updated state before per-token encode; this is a local storage intervention, not the official quantized/fused implementation.

damp.observations: Checked paper/abstract links did not establish an algorithm repository. arXiv feedback links were excluded. HF paper API404 and exact-title/ID repository searches did not verify author code.
damp.not_claimed: Absence of a verified link is not proof that author code is unpublished.

contract.codec: UINT8 affine; normalized value-axis H32; group32; FP16 scale/zero-point; original-coordinate FP16 high rows.
contract.budget: Paper default16/128 high rows=9.875bits/value; local8/128=9.4375bits/value, including scale/zero-point metadata but excluding indices/static/scratch.
contract.calibration: Pile validation;8 documents per each of4 domains;256 tokens/document;stride8;domain balanced.
contract.gdn_identity: Within a scalar-decay GDN head with fixed budget, persistence is a common positive multiplier and cannot change E top-k ranking. Not a general GDN2 result.
contract.runtime: Paper FP32 recurrent reference, fused SGLang decode and chunk-boundary prefill writes differ from local Native BF16 cache/eager per-token writes.
contract.unresolved: Exact metadata cast-before-code order, tie/floor/constant handling and overflow behavior are not completely specified by the checked paper.
contract.current_comparison: DAMP_PAPER_ADAPTED uses local synthetic TRAIN6/native stride8/r8/per-tokenP_PRE; neither original paper corpus/benchmark reproduction nor author-code verification.

qronos.provenance: Paper v3 Reproducibility section directly links this branch. Older v1 future-release wording is not the current evidence.
qronos.overlap: Data-aware rounding, reconstruction objectives, fixed grids, error correction and error diffusion predate RTPA/FA_CODE.
qronos.distinction: Inspected Qronos code performs offline sequential weight-column rounding using float/quantized activation covariances and least-squares updates. FA_CODE uses bounded runtime recurrent-write integer-code correction with a frozen state metric.
qronos.positioning: Recurrent-state extension/implementation and empirical study; no first-ever, SOTA, priority, or Qronos-equivalence claim.

independent_cpu_math_probe.limitation: Not official Triton/kernel or full-model parity. Tiny negative PSD eigenvalue retained as floating-point roundoff.

cpu_native_recurrence_probe.dtypes: q/k/v,beta,incoming state BF16; log-decay FP32; native update FP32
cpu_native_recurrence_probe.conclusion: At these points the reconstructed FP32 update exactly matches installed native state; FP32 z*q readout matches returned native output only after BF16 cast. Captured FP32 pre-output-cast objectives must not be labeled actual BF16 returned readouts.
cpu_native_recurrence_probe.arithmetic_boundary: Use l2norm(q).float() * (1 / sqrt(128)), preserving native reciprocal multiplication. An exploratory division variant changed a BF16 cast decision; it is not the registered capture arithmetic.
cpu_native_recurrence_probe.limitation: Two synthetic CPU tensor points only; not full-model, CUDA backend, arbitrary-input equivalence, or a performance measurement.
reproduce_program: zi=torch.zeros(16,128,128) if state is None else state[0].float()
